Class PhotoTexture

java.lang.Object
net.murat.material.PhotoTexture
All Implemented Interfaces:
RajaTexture
public class PhotoTexture extends Object implements RajaTexture
PhotoTexture is a texture that samples from a Bitmap with tiling support. Android adaptation: Uses Bitmap + int[] for fast, GC-free sampling.

    • sample

      public int sample(Point3 hitPoint, double u, double v)
      Description copied from interface: RajaTexture
      Samples the texture at the given surface point with UV coordinates.

      This method must be 100% garbage-free - no object allocation.

      Specified by:
      sample in interface RajaTexture
      Parameters:
      hitPoint - The surface point in world or local space
      u - The U texture coordinate (typically 0.0 - 1.0)
      v - The V texture coordinate (typically 0.0 - 1.0)
      Returns:
      Packed ARGB color (0xAARRGGBB) at this texture coordinate
